title: Twin Deck Solitaire

risk_factors: assembly: moderate unsupported overhang area (10.7% of surface)
moderate unsupported overhang area (10.7% of surface)

condition_results.description: The two boards are held in a fixed parallel stack with a clear open air gap between them, not touching or fused into one solid block.
Each board carries 33 genuinely pierced or drilled holes in the standard cross layout (66 total), not shallow decorative dimples.
64 pegs exist as separate loose cylindrical bodies, not fused to a board or to each other.
Every one of the 33 hole positions on the top board sits in true vertical alignment with its twin hole on the bottom board, forming a real straight-through transfer channel.
Each peg is a snug, removable friction fit in the 12mm holes -- close enough to stay seated, loose enough to lift out by hand.
condition_results.detail: cylindrical_fit requires numeric pin_diameter_mm and hole_diameter_mm
